summary: The vulnerability close-loop step runs again, and security image updates arrive within 15 minutes.

fixes.title: Vulnerability close-loop runs again
fixes.text: The close-loop step reaches its database again; a check now makes sure every step can load what it needs.

fixes.title: Security image updates within 15 minutes
fixes.text: Every installation checks for newer security images every 15 minutes and applies them without stopping a run.

fixes.title: Release checks run first
fixes.text: The quick release checks and the ring check run before the tests, so a problem is found in seconds.
